textureStrategy.format: portable embedded PNG in source GLB plus editable PNGs under source/textures/
textureStrategy.uvStrategy: Each render mesh has unique UV0 from cube/box projection plus a scaled UV1. LOD0 unique albedo/ORM/normal maps are cage-baked (high duplicate, inflate 0.038 m, Cycles selected-to-active). Basecolor does not carry baked AO; occlusion lives in ORM red. Checker/stretch review remains G3 and is not a self-pass.
textureStrategy.materialModel: glTF metallic-roughness with per-role unique maps rather than a recolored common shader
textureStrategy.wearRule: Wear is restricted to dock contact, tether contact, cassette latch, heat-throat, and service-handling regions; there is no global dirt layer.
